conflictOfInterest.details: Founding-stage isolation check: the accountable principal VSBDev operates the authoring, review, and finalization agents, so principal-level independence is absent. Agent-level role isolation was strictly maintained: no authoring history, other review output, or adjudication draft was read, and no other EmbeddedKnowledge role script was run during this review execution.

findings.finding: First-read clarity: The orientation scene immediately introduces the core clinical scenario (the uncheckable referral summary) to frame the learning goals. The prose is direct, highly accessible, and explains what the learner will study, why it matters, and how the three-tag clinical description system works, passing the first-read gate.

Worked example quality: The worked assembly is highly structured and clearly exposes expert decisions (such as excluding clinical inferences from finding lines, preserving separate lines for mood vs affect, and tracking shift patterns for the sleep element) rather than demonstrating calculations or final steps only.

Misconception repair: The lesson addresses the common error of 'strength drift' (e.g., converting a retrospective self-report of a five-day period into a diagnosed history of hypomania) by comparing three versions of the same five days in a table. It shows the learner the concrete consequences of losing sources and qualifiers downstream.

Constructive alignment: The open-response assessment items (such as item-triage-the-nine and item-past-episode-line) are perfectly aligned with the lesson's learning outcomes and objectives. The safety-critical triage rubric checks that learners treat unasked questions as gaps rather than assuming absence.

Terminology continuity: The glossary and lesson properly adopt the definitions for 'description', 'inference', 'mood', and 'affect' from their respective owning lessons (PSY-WEL-002 and PSY-INT-004) and declare these alignments explicitly, ensuring consistency across the psychiatry course track.

limitations: Expert-simulation review: This review represents a single-pass advisory input by a simulated learning-design expert under standard-lesson-v3 guidelines. No real learner testing was conducted.
Conflict of interest: The same GitHub principal (VSBDev) is responsible for the authoring and review run operators. Agent-level isolation was maintained, but principal-level independence is absent.

Scope restriction: The review is strictly bounded to learning-design metrics (e.g., clarity, coherence, practice, alignment, and transfer). Scientific accuracy, rights audits, and final typesetting checks are excluded.

Technical verification limits: No rendered build environment, screen reader, or keyboard navigation pathways were evaluated physically; findings are based solely on the static Markdown and JSON source files.
